about.heading: About
about.body: Senior AI-Augmented .NET Developer / Solution Architect with 15+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core Web APIs, React, Azure, and AI-assisted SDLC tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, MCP). Operates as a forward-deployed engineer — embedded directly inside client engineering teams building and shipping custom solutions. Has contributed to Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), HCL Technologies, NIIT Technologies, Collabera Inc., Randstad Technologies USA, SEW USA, and Neilson Financial Services in roles from Software Developer through Technical Lead and Project Lead. Broad domain expertise spanning BFSI, Insurance, Travel, Hi-Tech, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, and Enterprise HR/Payroll. Experienced designing microservices with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), OOAD/UML, SOLID, and design patterns, with strong proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, REST APIs, and front-end delivery. Spearheaded DataDog observability and NuGet instrumentation packages across platforms. Proven delivery across USA and UK with Fortune 500 global customers.
